name: Apple Platform Security Glossary
description: Apple Platform Security Glossary — 60 terms used in the Apple Platform Security Guide, covering hardware security primitives (Secure Enclave, AES engine), platform protections (ASLR, BAA, FileVault), and Apple-specific cryptographic terminology.
